source: Mark Lauren – ML 2.1 (Isolated Floor / Mobility Floor / Integrated Standing Exercises)

categories.name: Mobility Floor Exercises
categories.description: Improve the user's orthopedically safe range of motion and dynamic display of transitional strength and flexibility.

exercises.name: Glute Hip Up with knees bent
exercises.description: Lengthen and strengthen the musculature needed for simultaneous hip flexion and extension.
functions: Lengthen and strengthen the musculature needed for simultaneous hip flexion and extension
keyPoints: Fully extend through the hip of the lower leg
Actively pull the knee of the elevated leg towards your chest

exercises.name: Glute Hip Up with legs straight
exercises.description: Pull the toes down and keep the elevated leg as straight as possible. Try to keep the elevated leg perfectly vertical. Avoid letting the elevated leg externally rotate. Fully extend.
hooyah: Pull the toes down and keep the elevated leg as straight as possible
Try to keep the elevated leg perfectly vertical
Avoid letting the elevated leg externally rotate
Fully extend

exercises.name: Up & Over with knees bent
exercises.description: Improve simultaneous hip flexion and extension while preventing rotation of extended leg; Coordination of medial hip rotation and spinal rotation; Activation of anterior core.
functions: Improve simultaneous hip flexion and extension while preventing rotation of extended leg
Coordination of medial hip rotation and spinal rotation
Activation of anterior core
keyPoints: Press the lower leg into the ground while preventing external rotation
Pull the elevated leg to your chest
Reach to the sky with your hand while keeping your head on the ground
Return to the starting position
Repeat step 1, except reach across the body to the opposite hand

exercises.name: Up & Over with legs straight
exercises.description: By straightening the elevated leg, hip flexion / extension and control of rotation are made more difficult.
hooyah: By straightening the elevated leg, hip flexion / extension and control of rotation are made more difficult

exercises.name: Dead Bug with knees bent
exercises.description: Improve pelvic control during hip extension and flexion; Controlling rotation of extended leg during hip flexion and extension.
functions: Improve pelvic control during hip extension and flexion
Controlling rotation of extended leg during hip flexion and extension
keyPoints: Tighten abdominals and pull naval towards spine
Prevent movement of the pelvis
Fully extend the lower leg while preventing external rotation
Actively pull the elevated leg to the chest

exercises.name: Dead Bug with legs straight
exercises.description: Straighten the legs to increase flexibility of the hamstrings, calves, and soleus, and the difficulty of controlling rotation in the extended leg.
hooyah: Straighten the legs to increase flexibility of the hamstrings, calves, and soleus, and the difficulty of controlling rotation in the extended leg
keyPoints: Make yourself as long and straight as possible while keeping your lower back flat against the ground

exercises.name: Windshield Wiper with knees bent
exercises.description: Strengthen and lengthen leg adductors; Improve control of spinal rotation.
functions: Strengthen and lengthen leg adductors
Improve control of spinal rotation
keyPoints: Keep the thighs perpendicular to the body
Don’t rest the legs on the ground
Lower the left leg without moving the right leg
Lower the right leg to the left leg while keeping your shoulders on the ground
Reverse the exercise, and return to the starting position

exercises.name: Windshield Wiper with legs straight
exercises.description: Increase the flexibility of your hamstrings, calves, and soleus by straightening your legs. Controlling spinal rotation is also made more difficult.
hooyah: Increase the flexibility of your hamstrings, calves, and soleus by straightening your legs
Controlling spinal rotation is also made more difficult
keyPoints: Keep the legs straight
Pull the toes towards your face
Avoid excessive external rotation of the legs
Keep the legs perpendicular to your body
From the starting position – lower left leg, lower right leg, raise right leg, raise left leg

exercises.name: Y Cuff with rotation
exercises.description: Strengthen and activate musculature for posterior and anterior scapular tilting; Lengthen and strengthen range of motion for external rotation of shoulders and scapular retraction.
functions: Strengthen and activate musculature for posterior and anterior scapular tilting
Lengthen and strengthen range of motion for external rotation of shoulders and scapular retraction
keyPoints: Pull the hands through the armpits
Extend the arms at your sides
Your elbows should be facing away from your body
Externally rotate your thumbs and squeeze your shoulder blades together until your thumbs are pointing up at the sky again

exercises.name: Y Cuff with hands behind back
exercises.description: Place the hands on the lower to mid back and the let the elbows hang.
hooyah: Place the hands on the lower to mid back and the let the elbows hang
keyPoints: Squeeze the shoulder blades together and lift the elbows as high as you can while keeping your midsection tight

exercises.name: Hip Twist from plank
exercises.description: Improve control of lumbar and thoracic spine rotation; Lengthen muscles opposing spinal rotation.
functions: Improve control of lumbar and thoracic spine rotation
Lengthen muscles opposing spinal rotation
keyPoints: Rotate your heels to the left until they are resting on the ground
Don’t laterally shift the hips during rotation or allow your heels to fall to the ground
Rotate your heels to the right
Keep your arms straight
Push your body away from the ground so that the shoulder blades are flat against the upper back

exercises.name: Hip Twist from pillar
exercises.description: Perform the exercise from the pillar position to increase anterior core stability.
hooyah: Perform the exercise from the pillar position to increase anterior core stability

exercises.name: Twist & Reach with hips down
exercises.description: Lengthen and strengthen musculature needed for thoracic rotation; Challenge the shoulders to rotate independently of the hips.
functions: Lengthen and strengthen musculature needed for thoracic rotation
Challenge the shoulders to rotate independently of the hips
keyPoints: Maintain a straight line from your knees through your head
Push your bottom shoulder away from your head
Don’t let the hips move
Twist and reach as high as you can towards the sky

exercises.name: Twist & Reach with hips up
exercises.description: Bend at the hips. Fully rotate, turning your left arm towards the sky, while pushing through the lower arm.
hooyah: Bend at the hips
Fully rotate, turning your left arm towards the sky, while pushing through the lower arm

exercises.name: Moose Antler from lying position
exercises.description: Forward reaching arm – lengthen musculature opposing shoulder flexion past the head; Bent arm – strengthen musculature needed for scapular retraction while lengthening musculature opposing it.
functions: Forward reaching arm – lengthen musculature opposing shoulder flexion past the head
Bent arm – strengthen musculature needed for scapular retraction while lengthening musculature opposing it
keyPoints: Crawl the right hand as far forward as possible
Press the right arm into the ground
Place the right thumb on the back of the head
While pressing the right arm into the ground, lift the left elbow as high as possible

exercises.name: Moose Antler from kneeling position
exercises.description: Lengthen the entire chain of musculature from shoulders to ankles by performing this exercise from “child’s pose” with the hips down. After crawling your right hand as far forward as possible, press your right arm into the ground, while ensuring your hips are as low as possible.
hooyah: Lengthen the entire chain of musculature from shoulders to ankles by performing this exercise from “child’s pose” with the hips down
After crawling your right hand as far forward as possible, press your right arm into the ground, while ensuring your hips are as low as possible
keyPoints: Actively press the right arm into the ground, while keeping the hips down, and lift the left elbow as high as possible

exercises.name: Side Leg Lift from lying position
exercises.description: Leg ABduction while maintaining parallel feet.
functions: Leg ABduction while maintaining parallel feet
keyPoints: Lay on your side without tilting to your back or front side
Keep your legs straight and feet parallel
Elevated your leg as high as possible

exercises.name: Side Leg Lift from plank
exercises.description: Perform this exercise from a side pillar position. Keep your feet parallel. Push your hips forward to create a straight line from head to heels.
hooyah: Perform this exercise from a side pillar position
Keep your feet parallel
Push your hips forward to create a straight line from head to heels
keyPoints: Elevate the top leg as high as possible while keeping the feet parallel

exercises.name: Hip Drop on elbows
exercises.description: Lateral flexion and extension.
functions: Lateral flexion and extension
keyPoints: Support yourself using the top arm, if needed
Lower your hips to the ground, and then return to the starting position
Keep your hips from drifting forwards or backwards

exercises.name: Hip Drop on hands
exercises.description: Perform this exercise from your hands to increase the range of motion.
hooyah: Perform this exercise from your hands to increase the range of motion
keyPoints: Lower your hips as far as possible
Keep your supporting arm straight
Keep your midsection tight and naval drawn in towards your spine

exercises.name: Moon Walk supported on elbows
exercises.description: Adduction and Abduction of legs; Control lateral flexion of spine.
functions: Adduction and Abduction of legs
Control lateral flexion of spine
keyPoints: Support yourself with the top arm, if needed
Keep your body as straight as possible
Place the left foot in front of the right foot
Place the right foot in front of the left foot
After taking the needed steps forward, reverse the exercise to return to the starting position

exercises.name: Moon Walk supported on hands
exercises.description: Perform this exercise while supported on a single hand, if support from the top arm is not needed.
hooyah: Perform this exercise while supported on a single hand, if support from the top arm is not needed
keyPoints: Pivot around your hand
Keep your body straight
After completing your steps forward, repeat them going backwards to return to the starting position

exercises.name: Side Crunch with legs on ground
exercises.description: Lateral Flexion.
functions: Lateral Flexion
keyPoints: Don’t let your body drift to the front
Your hips should be in-line with the rest of your body
Raise your elbow straight up towards the sky
Keep this is a short movement

exercises.name: Side Crunch with legs elevated
exercises.description: Perform this exercise with your legs elevated to include leg adduction and abduction, while further challenging lateral flexion.
hooyah: Perform this exercise with your legs elevated to include leg adduction and abduction, while further challenging lateral flexion

exercises.name: Pointer straight
exercises.description: Spinal flexion and extension; Controlling rotation of the extended leg.
functions: Spinal flexion and extension
Controlling rotation of the extended leg
keyPoints: Bring your left elbow to your right knee
Raise the left arm, and reach straight ahead
Extend the right leg, and push through your right heel, locking out the right knee
Keep the knee and toes of the right foot pointing straight down at the ground
Keep your abdominals tight and belly button sucked in to avoid overextending through the lower back

exercises.name: Pointer arched
exercises.description: After touching your left elbow to your right knee, raise your left arm and right leg as high as possible without swinging or using momentum. Keep your midsection thight to prevent over extension through the lower back.
hooyah: After touching your left elbow to your right knee, raise your left arm and right leg as high as possible without swinging or using momentum
Keep your midsection thight to prevent over extension through the lower back

exercises.name: Straight Wide Leg from crawling position
exercises.description: Maintaining parallel feet during extension and Abduction of the elevated leg.
functions: Maintaining parallel feet during extension and Abduction of the elevated leg
keyPoints: Fully extend and straighten the elevated leg
Internally rotate the elevated leg so that the toes point down at the ground
Bring the elevated leg out to the side while keeping the knees and toes pointing straight down at the ground
Maintain a straight spine and level hips while abducting the elevated leg
This is a very short movement when done correctly

exercises.name: Straight Wide Leg from plank
exercises.description: Perform this exercise from a planking position to additionally challenge anterior core stability.
hooyah: Perform this exercise from a planking position to additionally challenge anterior core stability
keyPoints: Keep the elevated leg as straight as possible with the knees and toes pointing down at the ground
Maintain a straight spine from head to tailbone

exercises.name: Dirty Dog with legs bent
exercises.description: External rotation of the hips.
functions: External rotation of the hips
keyPoints: Elevate the left knee as high as possible without swinging the leg

exercises.name: Dirty Dog with kick-out
exercises.description: To further strengthen the external hip rotators and lengthen the adductors, straighten the elevated leg at the top of the movement.
hooyah: To further strengthen the external hip rotators and lengthen the adductors, straighten the elevated leg at the top of the movement
keyPoints: Keep your spine as straight and neutral as possible
Elevate your leg as high as possible
While keeping your knee at the same elevation, straighten your leg with your toes slightly pointing down at the ground

exercises.name: Hip Circle with legs bent
exercises.description: Hip Circumduction.
functions: Hip Circumduction
keyPoints: Raise your knee to the rear
And make as big of a circle as possible with the elevated knee
While making circles with your knee, keep your spine as long and neutral as possible
After making a complete circle, change directions to complete one repetition

exercises.name: Hip Circle with legs straight
exercises.description: Perform this exercise with the elevated leg straight to further challenge your strength and flexibility.
hooyah: Perform this exercise with the elevated leg straight to further challenge your strength and flexibility

exercises.name: Bloomer
exercises.description: Start in a push-up position with a long neutral spine, feet parallel, and arms shoulder width apart. While keeping your legs straight, walk your hands back towards your feet.
keyPoints: Start in a push-up position with a long neutral spine, feet parallel, and arms shoulder width apart
While keeping your legs straight, walk your hands back towards your feet
Push your weight straight back, and avoid lateral swaying of the hips
With your legs straight, hang from your hips with a relaxed spine
Roll your spine up, vertebrae by vertebrae, until you’re in a fully upright position
After standing erect, perform a big arm swing to the streamline position, and make yourself as tall as possible
Reverse the motion to return to the starting position

exercises.name: Deep Squat
exercises.description: Begin in the Inch Worm starting position. Walk your hands back towards your feet while bending your knees.
keyPoints: Begin in the Inch Worm starting position
Walk your hands back towards your feet while bending your knees
Keep your hips low and prevent swaying side to side
Maintain parallel feet
While keeping your hips low, walk your hips back until you can plant your heels
Extend your arms to the front, lift your chest, and stand up straight with our knees and toes pointing straight ahead
Reverse the motion by pushing your hips back and down into a deep squat with your feet parallel and knees pointing straight ahead
Once you can’t go any deeper, roll over the balls of your feet, and place your hands on the ground to the push-up position

exercises.name: Vertical Twist
exercises.description: Start in the Inch-Worm starting position. Walk your right leg back until your left knee is over your left ankle.
keyPoints: Start in the Inch-Worm starting position
Walk your right leg back until your left knee is over your left ankle
Perform a hip hinge and lift your arms to the streamline position, while keeping your trailing knee close to the ground
Keep your abdominals rock hard to avoid arching through the back
Twist to the left by pulling your left shoulder blade back
Twist to the right by pulling your right shoulder blade back

exercises.name: Kneeling Switch
exercises.description: Get in the Inch Worm starting position. From the push-up position, walk your right leg back until you can get into a single kneeling position with your left leg forward.
keyPoints: Get in the Inch Worm starting position
From the push-up position, walk your right leg back until you can get into a single kneeling position with your left leg forward
Your lead foot should be about one foot length in front of the lowered knee
Shift your weight onto your lead foot, and push your hip back slightly
Maintain a long, neutral spine with your arms extended to the front
Without moving your hips or upper body, place your trailing foot next to your lead foot
Stand up straight, and make sure your feet are parallel
Reverse the motion to return to the starting position

exercises.name: Hip Swirl
exercises.description: From the Spiderman starting position, make horizontal circles with your hips. Make a circle in one direction, and then make a circle in the opposite direction to complete one repetition.
keyPoints: From the Spiderman starting position, make horizontal circles with your hips
Make a circle in one direction, and then make a circle in the opposite direction to complete one repetition

exercises.name: Arm Circle
exercises.description: From the Spiderman starting position, reach your right arm straight past your head, and make a large circle in the sagittal plane. Keep your left knee from drifting out to the side.
keyPoints: From the Spiderman starting position, reach your right arm straight past your head, and make a large circle in the sagittal plane
Keep your left knee from drifting out to the side
Make the circle as big as possible
Keep your midsection tight
Place the knuckle of your index finger in your lower back, and pull your left shoulder blade back while looking up at the ceiling

exercises.name: A-Frame
exercises.description: From the Spiderman starting position, while keeping your hands on the ground, straighten the left leg, and pull the toes of the left foot up. Lower your elbow to the ground.
keyPoints: From the Spiderman starting position, while keeping your hands on the ground, straighten the left leg, and pull the toes of the left foot up
Lower your elbow to the ground
Keep your spine as long as possible
Keep your left knee pointing straight ahead

exercises.name: Saxon Tilt
exercises.description: From the Spiderman starting position, hip hinge to the bottom of a lunging position with your hands at the streamline position. Keep your midsection tight, and keep your ribs from showing.
keyPoints: From the Spiderman starting position, hip hinge to the bottom of a lunging position with your hands at the streamline position
Keep your midsection tight, and keep your ribs from showing
While keeping your right knee pointing straight down at the ground and your arms straight, bend to the side of the forward leg
Keep your midsection tight
Reverse the motion and bend to the opposite side of the forward leg
Keep your elbows straight, head in-line with your spine, and abdominals tight

exercises.name: Starfish Twist
exercises.description: Get into the Starfish starting position. While keeping your left arm reaching up towards the sky, turn your hips towards the ground as far as possible.
keyPoints: Get into the Starfish starting position
While keeping your left arm reaching up towards the sky, turn your hips towards the ground as far as possible
Turn the hips independently of the shoulders
After your hips are fully turned towards the ground, place your left hand on the ground so that your are in a good starting position for a push-up

exercises.name: Starfish Hip Drop
exercises.description: Begin in the Starfish position with your top leg in front of the bottom leg. While keeping the supporting arm straight and the top arm pointing straight up at the sky, lower your hips as far to the ground as possible.
keyPoints: Begin in the Starfish position with your top leg in front of the bottom leg
While keeping the supporting arm straight and the top arm pointing straight up at the sky, lower your hips as far to the ground as possible
After lowering the hips, return to the Starfish position
Rotate the hips without changing the position of your top arm
After rotating the hips fully, get into the starting position of a push-up

exercises.name: Starfish Push-Up
exercises.description: Get into the Starfish starting position. Rotate the hips.
keyPoints: Get into the Starfish starting position
Rotate the hips
After rotating the hips, drop down to the bottom of a push-up position
Push yourself off the ground, and return to the starting position of a push-up
Keep your midsection tight and stable as you push yourself up from the ground
If a regular push-up is too difficult, keep your knees on the ground as you push yourself up

exercises.name: Starfish Dive Bomber
exercises.description: From the starfish position, twist your hips towards the ground. Rotate your hips as far as possible without moving your top arm.
keyPoints: From the starfish position, twist your hips towards the ground
Rotate your hips as far as possible without moving your top arm
After rotating fully, drop down to the bottom of a push-up position
While keeping your knees on the ground, straighten your arms
Let yourself arch through your back
Pull your shoulders back and externally rotate the arms, creating a broad chest
Lightly pull the chin back, so that your head is in line with the rest of your spine
Lower your chest towards the ground, and at the same time, push your hips up into the air
In this position, your shoulders should roll forward into an anterior scapular tilt

exercises.name: Kickout
exercises.description: From the quadruped start position, rotate towards your right side, and kick your left leg straight out with your toes pointing up towards the ceiling. Plant the heel of the supporting foot on the ground.
keyPoints: From the quadruped start position, rotate towards your right side, and kick your left leg straight out with your toes pointing up towards the ceiling
Plant the heel of the supporting foot on the ground
Maintain a long neutral spine
Pull the shoulders back
After performing the kickout, return to the starting position

exercises.name: High Kick
exercises.description: After performing a Kickout, kick your left leg straight up into the air, while pushing your hips up and back. Fully straighten the supporting leg.
keyPoints: After performing a Kickout, kick your left leg straight up into the air, while pushing your hips up and back
Fully straighten the supporting leg
Push your chest down towards your feet
Return to the starting position

exercises.name: Side Kick
exercises.description: After performing a Kickout and a High Kick, bring your left foot as far over to the right side of your body as possible without rotating on your supporting foot. Keep your hips high and the supporting leg straight.
keyPoints: After performing a Kickout and a High Kick, bring your left foot as far over to the right side of your body as possible without rotating on your supporting foot
Keep your hips high and the supporting leg straight

exercises.name: Table Top
exercises.description: After performing a Side Kick, rotate on the supporting foot, while keeping your hips up, and plant your left foot on the ground. Try to arrive with your feet shoulder width apart and parallel.
keyPoints: After performing a Side Kick, rotate on the supporting foot, while keeping your hips up, and plant your left foot on the ground
Try to arrive with your feet shoulder width apart and parallel
Extend through your hips
Point your right arm straight up at the ceiling
Reverse the motion to return to the starting position and complete one full repetition

exercises.name: Narrow Squat
exercises.description: Vertical movement in the sagittal plane of motion, with a hip width stance, challenging ankle mobility and postural control in the bottom position.
functions: Vertical movement in the sagittal plane of motion, with a hip width stance, challenging ankle mobility and postural control in the bottom position
keyPoints: Push the hips straight back and then down while keeping your feet parallel and knees pointing straight ahead
Keep your chest elevated and midsection tight
Sink your hips down as far as possible while maintaining the described alignment

exercises.name: Wide Squat
exercises.description: Vertical movement in the sagittal plane of motion, with a slightly wider than shoulder width stance, challenging hip mobility and postural control in the bottom position.
functions: Vertical movement in the sagittal plane of motion, with a slightly wider than shoulder width stance, challenging hip mobility and postural control in the bottom position
keyPoints: With your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart and parallel, push your hip back and down while keeping your knees pointing straight ahead
Keep your chest upright and your midsection tight
Sink your hips down as far as possible

exercises.name: Staggered Squat
exercises.description: Challenge the flexibility of the rear ankle and lateral stability of the hips while squatting.
functions: Challenge the flexibility of the rear ankle and lateral stability of the hips while squatting
keyPoints: Place your left foot a half to a full foot length in front of the right foot
Keep your feet parallel and knees pointing straight ahead
Push your hips straight back, and sink into a squat with your chest up and midsection tight
Avoid letting the hips or knee of the rear foot drift laterally

exercises.name: Lateral Squat
exercises.description: Challenge lateral stability and control of rotation during movement in the coronal plane.
functions: Challenge lateral stability and control of rotation during movement in the coronal plane
keyPoints: Take a step to the left with your left leg
Keep your feet parallel
While keeping the right leg straight, bend the left leg, and push your hips straight back
Extend through the left hip, and draw the right leg to the left leg while maintaining parallel feet
Focus on preventing lateral drift of the left knee. It should point straight ahead throughout the exercise
Your upper body should face straight ahead the entire time
After arriving in an upright standing position, repeat the exercise going to the right to complete the second repetition

exercises.name: Stepping Lunge
exercises.description: Forward and backward movement through the sagittal plane.
functions: Forward and backward movement through the sagittal plane
keyPoints: Maintain an upright torso with your midsection tight. Avoid arching through the back
Keep the head over the shoulders
Point the trailing knee straight down at the ground
Your legs should remain hip width apart. Do not step out to the side for added stability
After stepping into the bottom of a lunge, step forward with the right leg, and return to an upright standing position with your feet parallel and midsection tight
Step back with the right leg into a backwards lunge, with an upright torso and the trailing knee pointing straight down
Step backwards with the left leg, pushing off your left heel, and return to the original standing position to complete one repetition

exercises.name: Side Lunge
exercises.description: Lateral movement through the frontal plane of motion.
functions: Lateral movement through the frontal plane of motion
keyPoints: Keep your feet parallel throughout the exercise
While keeping your right leg straight and bending your left knee, push your hips back, while keeping your chest up
Keep your left knee pointing in the same direction as your feet (to the front)
Push off your left heel, and return to the starting position
As you return to the starting position, do not let the toes of the left foot turn out

exercises.name: Tipsy Step
exercises.description: Cross stepping the body challenges postural control while shifting the the hips in the transverse plane of motion stretching the IT band, medial hip rotators, and hip flexors on the way down and strengthening adductors in the bottom position.
functions: Cross stepping the body challenges postural control while shifting the the hips in the transverse plane of motion stretching the IT band, medial hip rotators, and hip flexors on the way down and strengthening adductors in the bottom position
keyPoints: With your body remaining facing forward, step across your body into a lunge
Maintain an upright torso that remains facing in the same direction that you started in
Keep the midsection tight to avoid arching the back
Point the trailing knee straight down at the ground

exercises.name: Straight Lunge
exercises.description: Improved balance, flexibility and joint alignment during front and back movement in the sagittal plane of motion.
functions: Improved balance, flexibility and joint alignment during front and back movement in the sagittal plane of motion
keyPoints: While maintaining a tall, upright torso, take a big step forward so that you land with your left knee over your left ankle
Keep your abdominals tight, and avoid arching through the back
The trailing knee points straight down at the ground
From the first lunging position, with your left leg forward, push off your left heel, and take a giant step backwards so that you land in a deep lunging position with your right leg forward
Maintain an upright torso, with your abdominals flexed, and point the trailing knee straight down at the ground

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description: Front to back bending movement with a neutral spine and bent knees.
functions: Front to back bending movement with a neutral spine and bent knees
keyPoints: Push your hips back, and bend forward with the knees slightly bent
Keep your midsection tight and your back flat
Only go as far down as you can while maintaining a neutral spine
Feet remain parallel with knees facing forward

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
exercises.description: Front to back bending at the hips with straight legs; Lengthen and strengthen the hamstrings and calves; Strengthen the spinal erectors and lengthen the latissimus dorsi, especially in the bottom position.
functions: Front to back bending at the hips with straight legs
Lengthen and strengthen the hamstrings and calves
Strengthen the spinal erectors and lengthen the latissimus dorsi, especially in the bottom position
keyPoints: With your feet parallel and hip width apart, push your hips back, and bend forward
Continue to bend forward until your feel a stretch in the bottom position
Go only as far as you can without rounding the back. Keep your spine in a neutral position
In the bottom position, make yourself as long and straight as possible while keeping your midsection tight

exercises.name: 1-Legged Deadlift
exercises.description: Unilateral hip hinging with bent legs to challenge the control of rotation and stability of the supporting leg.
functions: Unilateral hip hinging with bent legs to challenge the control of rotation and stability of the supporting leg
keyPoints: Push your hips straight back and bend forward with the upper body while keeping your spine long and neutral
Toes of the supporting foot should face straight ahead
Keep the knee of the elevated leg pointing straight down

exercises.name: 1-Legged RDL
exercises.description: Unilateral hip hinging with straight legs to challenge the control of rotation for both legs, especially aiding in stability of the supporting leg; Stretch the hamstring and calf of the supporting leg, while strengthening the medial rotators of the elevated leg.
functions: Unilateral hip hinging with straight legs to challenge the control of rotation for both legs, especially aiding in stability of the supporting leg
Stretch the hamstring and calf of the supporting leg, while strengthening the medial rotators of the elevated leg
keyPoints: With the toes of you supporting foot pointing straight ahead , lift your right leg behind yourself while hinging forward with the upper body
Keep the feet as parallel as possible and knee of elevated leg pointing straight down at the ground
Maintain a straight line from the heel of the elevated leg to the head

exercises.name: Stork Stance
exercises.description: Challenge stability and posture control during hip flexion in a standing position.
functions: Challenge stability and posture control during hip flexion in a standing position
keyPoints: Lift your left knee as high as possible while standing up as tall and straight as possible
The feet should remain parallel with your toes pointing straight ahead
Keep the leg of the supporting leg totally straight
Tighten your abdominals to avoid arching through the back

exercises.name: Gate Swing
exercises.description: Challenge the ability to externally rotate a knee away from it’s contralateral shoulder in a standing position during hip flexion.
functions: Challenge the ability to externally rotate a knee away from it’s contralateral shoulder in a standing position during hip flexion
keyPoints: While keeping the supporting leg and upper body straight, lift the left knee as high possible
From the top position, rotate the left knee to the outside while pulling the right shoulder blade back to prevent movement through the upper body
Reverse the motion, and return to the starting position to complete one repetition

exercises.name: Cross Step
exercises.description: Challenge control of supination and pronation in the feet to improve the mechanics for cross body stepping.
functions: Challenge control of supination and pronation in the feet to improve the mechanics for cross body stepping
keyPoints: Begin with a good Stork Stance posture
Step across the right foot with the left foot
As you step across the supporting right foot with the left foot, draw the right shoulder blade back
In the bottom position, prevent supination of the supporting foot, while ensuring pronation of the elevated left foot

exercises.name: Straddle Step
exercises.description: Challenge control of lateral movement.
functions: Challenge control of lateral movement
keyPoints: Lift your left leg, and get into a good Stork Stance
From Stork Stance, step to the left while keeping your feet parallel
As soon as your left foot comes in contact with the ground, immediately and aggressively drive your hips straight back to stop the sideways movement
Keep your chest up and abdominals tight, while sinking into a wide squat
From the bottom of a wide squat, lightly push off the left heel to return to Stork Stance

The push off should be just hard enough to get you out of a squat and your left leg into the air. The last portion of the movement, before getting to Stork Stance, should be a pulling movement using your leg adductors
